title: Slotless runner source protection
description: Opt-in: run from GUI/Aqua on macOS with Pi/LiteLLM and Cursor authenticated. Set FARMSLOT_REVIEW_RUNNER_PROOF_OUTPUT to a new private evidence root. Three tiny real reviews in isolated gateways; no live farm mutation. Each actual worker process attempts a source write before the provider starts and must record EPERM with source unchanged.

pi-native.cmd: TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=services/gateway/tsconfig.json FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_READ_ONLY=1 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_ROUNDS=1 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_RUNNER=pi FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_MODEL=litellm/claude-opus-5-5 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_TRANSPORT=native node --import tsx scripts/runner-validation/gateway/slotless-review-retention.mts "$FARMSLOT_REVIEW_RUNNER_PROOF_OUTPUT/pi-native"
pi-native.intent: Pi completes a read-only native review through the production authenticated gateway and records its conversation.

cursor-native.cmd: TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=services/gateway/tsconfig.json FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_READ_ONLY=1 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_ROUNDS=1 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_RUNNER=cursor FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_MODEL=composer-2.5 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_EFFORT=none FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_TRANSPORT=native node --import tsx scripts/runner-validation/gateway/slotless-review-retention.mts "$FARMSLOT_REVIEW_RUNNER_PROOF_OUTPUT/cursor-native"
cursor-native.intent: Cursor completes the same source/task boundary with GUI keychain access.

pi-terminal.cmd: TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=services/gateway/tsconfig.json FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_READ_ONLY=1 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_ROUNDS=1 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_RUNNER=pi FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_MODEL=litellm/claude-opus-5-5 FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_TRANSPORT=tmux node --import tsx scripts/runner-validation/gateway/slotless-review-retention.mts "$FARMSLOT_REVIEW_RUNNER_PROOF_OUTPUT/pi-terminal"
pi-terminal.intent: Pi also completes a cold terminal review read-only; no unsupported warm-session assertion.
